name: @dropfort/dropfort_module_build
description: A basic Drupal module/theme set up to give a starting point for development.

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf bin && rm -rf vendor
scripts.build: npm run compile:styles && npm run compile:scripts
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && npm run clean && npm install --omit dev
scripts.build:dev: npm run compile:styles:dev && npm run compile:scripts:dev
scripts.compile:styles: npm run compile:sass -- --no-source-map && npm run compile:css -- --no-map
scripts.compile:styles:dev: npm run compile:sass -- --embed-source-map && npm run compile:css
scripts.lint: npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:scripts && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:styles:fix && npm run lint:scripts:fix && npm run lint:php:fix
scripts.lint:styles: npm run stylelint && npm run prettier -- --check
scripts.lint:styles:fix: npm run stylelint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write
scripts.lint:scripts: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check
scripts.lint:scripts:fix: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write
scripts.test:compatibility:js: echo 'This project does not define javascript compatiblity tests'
scripts.watch: npm run watch:js & npm run watch:sass

author: Coldfront Labs Inc.
